publication_status: Not published by this retention step. Visual and package acceptance are separate additive decisions.
boundaries: CI artifacts are retained byte-exactly; earlier outcomes remain separate and unchanged.
PNG files render the opened WPF client visual tree, excluding its native frame. Image decoding is not a usability or fidelity review.
UIA and injected event/callback controls do not establish physical input, native file-picker interaction or audible hardware playback.
Authored project and CPR controls do not establish proprietary reference behavior, complete CPR compatibility or complete Windows fidelity.
No development application ZIP is downloaded, executed or accepted by this retention step.
Prepared playback invalidation is covered by separate portable fake-audio controls, not by hardware playback in this native run.
package_identity_source: Successful CI receipt; independent archive audit is separate.

findings: The successful native workflow exercised the automation editor through scoped UIA, routed keyboard input and a production curve-input callback.
Shared volume and pan edits, Read state, stale/invalid input protection, undo/redo, exact render restoration and minimum-size client captures passed the committed gates.
The receipt gates were rechecked against the pinned commit during retention; this is not an additional native application execution.
Manual image review, independent archive audit and release acceptance remain separate decisions.
